text.en: Annex "B" of Executive Order No. 453, Series of 1997, is herebyrepealed

The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" hereof (PTA Items Not
in the CEPT Scheme), as classified
under Section
104 of the Tariff and
Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be subject to the ASEAN rates of duty as
indicated in Column 4 of Annex "An. The rates so indicated shall be applied to imports
coming from ASEAN Member Countries.

The ASEAN rate of duty indicated in Column 4 of Annex "An shall
be in effect until such products are transferred to the CEPT Inclusion List in which case
the CEPT rate of duty thereof under the Executive Order effecting said transfer shall
In the event that subsequent
are made in the basic
(MFN) Philippine rate of duty on any of the articles listed in Annex "An to a rate lower
than the rate prescribed
in Column 4, such article shall automatically
be accorded the
corresponding
reduced rate of duty.
In the event that the MFN rates of the products
listed in Annex "An are modified higher than the rates indicated in column 4 thereof, the
ASEAN rates prescribed in said column 4 shall apply.
The Margins of Preference
(MOPs) accorded
under the ASEAN
Preferential
Trading Arrangements
shall no longer Qe extended to any of the products
listed in Annex ..A'r hereof.

From the date of effectivity of this Orde,., all articles listed in Annex
" A" entered or withdrawn from warehouses
in the Philippines for consumption
imposed the rates of duty therein prescribed subject to qualification
under the Rules of
as provided
for in the Protocol
the Agreement
on the ASEAN
Preferential
Trading Arrangements
signed by the AEM on 15 December 1995.

All other items covered by the repealed Annex "8" of ExecutivE
Order No. 453 but not listed in Annex "A" hereof shall be subject to the basic (MFN'
Philippine rate of duty applicable at the time of importation.

All decrees, order, issuances, and rules and regulations
which are contrary to or inconsistent with this Executive
Order are hereby
repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
